text:
Three statements about electric charge are given.
1
An ammeter directly measures how much electric charge is in an object.
2
A moving electric charge can be detected by an ammeter.
3
A flow of electric charge is an electric current.
Which statements are correct?
A
1 and 2 only
B
1 and 3 only
C
2 and 3 only
D
1, 2 and 3
subject: Physics
